title: Customer-Visible Burst Audit Trail and Deferred SLA Credit Resolution
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Customers see intermittent mismatches between their observed dedicated pool throughput on the Console and the monthly invoice when bursts are applied or reconciled across regions. Root causes include delayed aggregation of per-tenant burst fingerprints, race conditions between leaky-bucket drains and daily ledger snapshots, and lack of an auditable customer-facing trail for deferred SLA credit decisions.

Goal: Implement an auditable, customer-visible burst attribution trail plus a deferred credit resolution workflow that: (1) produces a human-readable audit log per tenant for any burst or retroactive credit adjustment, (2) ensures deterministic ordering of ledger writes to avoid double-counting, and (3) exposes a dispute-able SLA credit reason code in the billing export and Console usage UI.
acceptance_criteria: Console displays a per-tenant burst audit timeline for the last 90 days with entries for allocation, drain, reconciliation, and credit issuance
Billing export CSV includes a "sla_credit_code" column with standardized codes and links to audit log entries
Ledger write path is idempotent and enforced by a 2-phase commit coordinator for daily snapshots
End-to-end test simulating overlapping bursts yields stable final ledger state in 100/100 CI runs
Customer-facing dispute flow creates a ticket with the full audit trail attached
design_summary: We will add a lightweight burst-event audit table (append-only) keyed by (tenant_id, burst_fingerprint, event_timestamp, event_type). Events: ALLOC, START_DRAIN, DRAIN_COMPLETE, RECONCILE_DECISION, SLA_CREDIT_EMITTED, AUDIT_NOTE. The metering pipeline (per-region aggregators) will append events as they observe state transitions; a central reconciler will subscribe to the event stream, compute deterministic ordering by (fingerprint + sequencer epoch), and emit ledger deltas through an idempotent write API. A separate 'deferred credit controller' handles policy evaluation (automatic vs manual) and emits SLA_CREDIT_EMITTED events only after recording the decision in the audit table. The Console will render events by querying the audit table and linking to the billing export entry. We will not change existing pricing models or invoicing format beyond adding the sla_credit_code column.
decisions: Use append-only audit table instead of mutating existing ledger rows to preserve history
Perform reconciliation deterministically in a single-region sequencer to avoid cross-region race conditions; failover uses sequencer leadership transfer
Expose standardized SLA credit reason codes to Console and billing export (e.g., SLC-01 slow-shed, SLC-02 double-charge-guard, SLC-03 late-aggregation)
Keep immediate customer notifications opt-in for the first rollout to limit noise
implementation_steps: Schema: create burst_audit_events table with indexes on tenant_id and burst_fingerprint
Metering: instrument per-region aggregator to emit ALLOC and START_DRAIN events (ENG: change set in metering repo)
Reconciler: implement central sequencer service to subscribe to events, compute deterministic ordering, and call ledger idempotent write API
Ledger API: add idempotency token handling and a 2-phase commit path for daily snapshot writes
Deferred credit controller: implement policy engine (ruleset configurable via Console feature flag)
Console UI: new "Burst history" panel on Dedicated usage page and billing export column
Backfill job: for last 180 days run backfill to populate audit events from raw aggregator logs for high-impact tenants
Documentation: PRD and runbook updates in Confluence; customer FAQ draft for billing team
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): enable event emission and audit table in staging; sequencer leader single-node; 2 non-critical tenants opted-in
Phase 2 (Beta): open opt-in to all tenants; Console shows audit timeline; billing export contains sla_credit_code but credits still processed manually
Phase 3 (GA): automated deferred credit controller enabled; backfill completed for >=90% active tenants; notify customers via release notes
Rollback: disable deferred controller, keep audit table read-only and show note in Console explaining temporary manual processing
testing_plan: Unit: idempotent ledger write tests and sequencer ordering fuzz tests
Integration: synthetic workload that creates overlapping bursts across two regions and assert final ledger equality
Load: run burst-event fanout at 10x expected peak to validate event DB and sequencer performance
Chaos: simulate sequencer failover and ensure no duplicate credits emitted
E2E: billing export parse and match against ledger for a sample of 50 tenants
metrics: Number of retroactive credit adjustments per-week
Percent of reconciliations that include an audit trace link in Console
Incidents caused by double-write or ordering races
blockers: Coordination with billing exports team for schema change
Sequencer leader implementation requires additional infra quotas in prod
Backfill for large tenants may take longer than estimated and needs throttling safeguards
